rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Strilli
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 1993).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 1993 as 'Strilli'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. Mild fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form.
